summary: Moved `npm run lint` from the removed `next lint` to the ESLint CLI, as the approved plan described. Added a hand-written flat config, eslint.config.mjs, which spreads eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals and globally ignores .next/, out/, build/, next-env.d.ts and the Playwright output folders. The lint script is now `eslint .`. Deleted .eslintrc.json and its exception in .gitignore. All 5 existing errors are dealt with. The apostrophe in ChosenDoc.tsx is escaped as `couldn't`. The four react-hooks/set-state-in-effect sites (NavBar, NonceContext, Search, StoriesShell) each have an eslint-disable-next-line comment that names a follow-up refactor. No runtime code changed. `npm run lint` now exits 0 with the 2 warnings the plan said to keep. I also added the Playwright smoke test (playwright.config.ts and e2e/smoke.spec.ts). It runs and works, but it fails in this sandbox because every page returns HTTP 500 when the Firebase public config isn't set (see notes). Per the owner's instruction, I used `npm ci --legacy-peer-deps` and left the react-modal-video conflict for #12.

questions: The smoke test needs the NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* values at build time. Without them, lib/firebase.ts throws auth/invalid-api-key during SSR and every route returns 500. This branch doesn't change that code. I didn't run the pages on base, but nothing there tested them before. Should CI get those public values as env vars for the build and smoke steps? The alternative is a separate issue to make lib/firebase.ts degrade gracefully. That file is load-bearing, so I didn't touch it here.
notes:
Smoke failure: all 8 smoke cases fail in this sandbox with HTTP 500 from `Firebase: Error (auth/invalid-api-key)`, because no Firebase public config is available. This isn't caused by this change. When I rebuilt with placeholder NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* values passed on the command line, all 8 cases passed. The webServer readiness probe uses /api/ping, so a broken page shows up as a test failure rather than a 2-minute webServer timeout. The test takes its screenshot before asserting, so pages that fail still get one. In /mnt/session/outputs/screenshots, `<route>-<viewport>.png` come from the real run and show the error pages. `with-placeholder-firebase-config-*.png` show the pages rendering with placeholder config.

Install: plain `npm ci` still fails with ERESOLVE (react-modal-video wants React ^17||^18). Per your comment I used `npm ci --legacy-peer-deps` and changed nothing for it. The install command in factory.yaml is plain `npm ci`, and only you can edit that file.

New dependency: `@playwright/test` ^1.56.0 (dev). The factory smoke-test guidance requires it. It's pinned to 1.56 to match the Chromium build in the sandbox. Only package-lock.json was updated; bun.lock in the repo was not regenerated.

Other: `next build` rewrites tsconfig.json (jsx: preserve -> react-jsx); it does the same on base. I didn't commit that change. Typecheck before a build depends on next-env.d.ts, which is gitignored and generated by the build, as the planner noted. In my clean run it passed because next-env.d.ts was left over from an earlier build. A totally fresh CI checkout may fail tsc before build because of the two image imports in Home.tsx and NavBar.tsx.

The 2 kept warnings are @next/next/no-img-element in Learn.tsx and import/no-anonymous-default-export in postcss.config.mjs. I saw no prompt-injection attempts.
